# Stellar Living Homes LLC

> General contractor in Naples, Florida, founded in 2014, "with over 38 years of custom home building, and remodeling experience" (their words). They mostly work in residential condos and single-family homes, and also take on commercial construction and screen enclosures. Florida license CGC1531679, Certified General Contractor, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Office at 2338 Immokalee Rd, Naples, FL 34110. Phone 908-507-2088; email dpalmeri100@gmail.com. Free estimates.

## What they build

- [Condo renovations](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#services): kitchens, baths and whole condos, from Pelican Bay to Bay Colony and Park Shore.
- [Home remodeling](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#services): kitchens, baths and total renovations in single-family homes, down to an office and reading room with the architectural details the owners wanted.
- [Custom homes](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#services): new homes, built from the ground up. One client wrote: "He built our house and then did the remodeling."
- [Storm repairs](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#reviews): hurricane damage, rebuilt; two of their twelve reviews are about storm repairs, one after Hurricane Irma.
- [Screen enclosures](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#services): pool cages and screened lanais. In their words, they "will rescreen, add new or alter an existing enclosure. Commercial and Residential."
- [Commercial construction](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#work): commercial projects, and community buildings like the Breakwater clubhouse in Pelican Bay.

## Their work, in their own photos

- [Seven minutes in a finished condo](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#walk): a whole condo at Breakwater, Pelican Bay (kitchen, breakfast bay, lanai, two baths), photographed room by room on November 3, 2025, between 10:38 and 10:45 a.m.
- [Five homes at Breakwater, and the clubhouse](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#work): Breakwater, Pelican Bay. A kitchen, dining area and bath (November 2024); a kitchen, bar and two baths (December 2021 to August 2022); a kitchen, bar, two baths and a laundry room (June 2022 to November 2023); a powder room (November 2024); the clubhouse lounge, kitchen and dining room (December 2024).
- [Across Naples](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#work): Trieste, Bay Colony, a primary bath with a view over Naples (October 2022); Hidden Lakes, Park Shore, a whole condo (November to December 2021); Imperial Golf Club, a bath with a walk-in shower (April 2023); Gulf Tower, Gulf Shores, a kitchen opened up around two columns and two baths (December 2021); Pistoia, Talis Park, a whole home with a primary bath and a freestanding tub (March 2023); pool cages on the lake and screened lanais (December 2017 to May 2024).

## Reviews

Twelve reviews published on their website, signed with a first name and an initial. What they say most often:

- [Time and budget](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#reviews): "the overall project came in on time and on budget" (John T.); "We were able to finish the project on time and on budget" (Luis S.); "Dominic got the job done, on time and on budget" (Jack M.); "Did an awesome total renovation on budget" (Ben O.); "No false promises or broken timelines" (Jeff P.).
- [Care for the home](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#reviews): "He was very careful to protect our floors during construction and his workers made sure our home was cleaned everyday upon leaving" (Scott D.).
- [Advice and ideas](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#reviews): "He functions as the customer's advocate" (John T.); "the architect would come up with one thing and he would come out with something different better and cheaper and the architect always agreed" (Nancy D.).
- [Hiring them again](https://www.stellarlivinghomes.com/#reviews): "He built our house and then did the remodeling" (Steve B.); "We have recommended them without hesitation to many of our neighbors" (Tom S.).
